utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need donations sorted, the tools listed, and a few volunteers for pickup and drop-off. If you want, I can bring the tools at 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’ll bring the tools at 3 PM, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — I’ll bring the tools at 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — I’m mostly worried about the pickup schedule and whether we have enough boxes and tape. If you can help check what’s still missing, that would be a huge relief.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check what’s still missing and help sort out the pickup schedule too. I’ll circle back with an update soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — that would really help. Please let me know as soon as you’ve got the missing items and pickup times sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s start with the most urgent repairs and make a quick list. I’ll keep it organized and share the location as soon as we have it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds great, Rosa — I can help with the urgent list and coordinate pickup on Thursday if needed. Morning after school drop-off still works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That works perfectly, Mara — thank you. I’ll note Thursday morning after drop-off and start the urgent list so we’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet, then? Just let me know when the date is confirmed, and I can help with donations or calls.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — once the date’s confirmed, I can help with the repair drive too. Just let me know where and when to show up, and I’ll bring a couple tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can help with that—I'll swing by after my errands and take a look at the porch step and gate.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Ira — I’ll keep everyone posted and let folks know you’re coming by after your errands. Thanks for checking on the porch step and gate.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’ll head over once I’m done and take a look.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. We’re meeting by the community shed Saturday morning, and your help there would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, that’s right — donations and repairs for the neighborhood stuff. I heard they’re still collecting tools and supplies, and hoping for a good turnout this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’s right, Tess. If anyone can spare tools, lumber, or a few hours on Saturday, we’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so I’m still catching up on the latest. If you hear anything current, let me know—I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine, Nell. I’m still looking for the exact plan and time for the repair drive, so please let me know once you hear anything current.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do, Eli—thanks. I’ll keep an ear out and pass along the latest as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s jot down the urgent stuff first, then I can skim the list and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — let’s list the urgent tools first, and I can bring a drill, hammer, and a few screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — those cover a lot. I’ll skim the list and add anything obvious we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not yet — I’m still double-checking the details before I confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — I’m still good to swing by late, and a flyer would be great when you have one.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ll double-check the details and get you the flyer once I’ve confirmed everything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check our supplies and make a quick list of what’s still missing, then we can split it up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds great, Cleo—I’ll keep an eye out for the location and help track the missing supplies once you have the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Opal — I’ll get the list together and bring it over as soon as I finish the inventory.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Morning after drop-off still works for me, and I can line the repair drive up around Thursday pickup too. What time works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Morning after drop-off still works for me, and Thursday pickup help is great. What time do you want to aim for?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still available to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s wonderful, thank you! The more hands we have, the faster we can get everything fixed. Want me to put your name down and bring you a flyer?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Cleo — a quick inventory would really help. Then we can see what donations we still need for the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll make a quick inventory and list the gaps, then I’ll let you know what we still need for the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still good to take a look at the porch step and front gate after my errands. If you need anything else for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep track of the repair drive location and let you know if anything else comes up. Your help with the porch step and front gate is much appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Opal — I’ll check in after my errands and help with the porch step and front gate.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive get a confirmed date yet? I can help sort donations or make calls—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces too—do you know if the date’s been confirmed yet?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet, I haven’t heard a confirmed date. I can help sort donations or make calls—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive. What still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’d be great—could you help sort the donated tools and set up the tables? I can bring my drill, hammer, and a few screwdrivers too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and set up the tables. I’ll bring a few tools too, and we can start around 10 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great—I'll add your name and pass along a flyer so the neighbors can jump in too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Quinn. That would really help us out a lot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I'll keep spreading the word and make sure folks know they’re welcome to join the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Morning after drop-off still works best for me, and I’ll line up the repair drive around that. Thanks again for offering to help with Thursday pickup.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning after drop-off sounds good to me. Just let me know the exact time, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — I’ll confirm the exact morning time after drop-off and send it over. Thanks, Eli; I really appreciate your help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll sort the donations, make a tools list, and see who can help with pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — let me know if you want me to handle pickup or drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — that’d be a big help. I’ll let you know once I’ve got the list together.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Hana — I’m mostly worried about the pickup schedule and making sure we have enough boxes and tape. If you can help check what’s still missing, that would be a huge relief.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check that — I’ll confirm the pickup schedule and see what boxes and tape we still need before I say anything for sure.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — I’m a little late, but I can help sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — I’ll take a quick pass at the urgent repairs list and then we can split the tools and sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll start on the donated tools and watch the sign-in table while you handle the urgent list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I may have missed an update, but I can check around and see what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Noah — that’d be great. I can also check who still needs a hand and connect people if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that helps a lot — I’ll check around for the supplies list and see what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I can sort the donated tools and keep an eye on the sign-in table. Just let me know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 3 PM works for me — I’ll bring the tools then.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive, right? Just want to make sure I’ve got that straight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — the repair drive. I’m keeping it organized, and we’re still waiting on the location details; I’ll share them with the block as soon as we have them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — I’ll wait for the location details. Just let me know as soon as you have them.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
